verse.verse_1: When the heaven shall be cleft,
verse.verse_2: And when the stars shall be scattered,
verse.verse_3: And when the seas are flowed out,
verse.verse_4: And when the graves are ransacked,
verse.verse_5: Each soul shall know that which it sent afore and that which it left behind.
verse.verse_6: O man! what hath beguiled thee concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
verse.verse_7: Who created thee, then moulded thee, then proportioned thee?
verse.verse_8: In whatsoever form He listed He constructed thee.
verse.verse_9: By no means! Aye, ye belie the the Requital.
verse.verse_10: Verify there are for you guardians,
verse.verse_13: Verily the pious shall be in Delight.
verse.verse_14: And verily the ungodly shall be in a Scorch.
verse.verse_15: Roasted they shall be therein on the Day of Requital.
verse.verse_16: And thence they shall not be allowed to be absent.
verse.verse_17: And what shall make thee know whatsoever the Day of Requital is?
verse.verse_18: Again, what shall make thee know whatsoever the Day of Requital is?
verse.verse_19: It is a Day whereon no soul shall own aught of power for any soul; and the command on that Day will be Allah's.
